brandWarnings: BRAND NOTE: no custom public/og.jpg — the platform will serve the og.grok.me placeholder. Custom cards are the default for games of every kind (DOM board/word games included), whimsical apps, creative tools, and brand-forward pages — only plain utilities (converters, CRUD trackers, admin dashboards) keep the placeholder. If this app is not a plain utility, finish the brand-asset pass per /workspace/.grok/skills/og/SKILL.md.
